LanguageData.VQE_AirlockJammed: Airlock jammed shut. Must be forced open.
LanguageData.VQE_Alert_CriticalCryptoGenerators_Desc: A cryptogenerator only has enough fuel left for less than a day. When fuel runs out, it will meltdown, destroying everything in radius.
LanguageData.VQE_HeroJoinsDesc: The {PAWN_title} known as {PAWN_nameDef} has emerged from a cryptosleep casket in a daze. Once they regain their bearings, they will join your colony.\n\n{PAWN_nameFull} is the legendary blacksmith of a renowned spacefaring civilization, famed for their mastery of cryptoparticle technology. A gifted crafter and battle-hardened warrior, {PAWN_labelShort} wears a set of cryptotech armor from their lost people. But beneath their skill and strength lies a heavy burden of guilt, a unique psychological condition born from the crushing sorrow of being the last living member of their civilization. This grief gnaws at {PAWN_possessive} mind over time, slowly deepening into despair. However, engaging in work that aligns with their passions: especially crafting, can slow the progression. If managed carefully, the guilt will eventually transform into acceptance, and with time, begin to fade.
LanguageData.VQE_InitiateScanDesc: Initiate the proximity scan to find large signatures in the area. The scan is bound to generate enough of an energy signature to attract a mechanoid hive.
LanguageData.VQE_QuestCompletedMessage: This is the only opportunity to craft more legendary crypto gear, provided you have the resources to do so. You can secure the site and send more resources in, but once you leave it, you will never be able to find it again.
LanguageData.VQE_RestartGeneratorDesc: Restart the cryptogenerator. It has enough fuel to run continuously for three days, after which it will critically meltdown. The strong energy signature is bound to attract the mechanoid hive.
LanguageData.VQE_RestartWarning: Restarting the cryptogenerator will cause continuous mechanoid attacks.
LanguageData.VQE_ScanStarted: The scan will take some time to complete. Leaving the site will cancel the scan.
LanguageData.VQE_ScavengeDesc: Clean up the {0} while searching for valuable materials.
LanguageData.VQE_StudyBlackBoxDesc: Access the data on the black box to find out what transpired.
LanguageData.VQE_StudyBlueprintsDesc: Study the ancient blueprints and diagrams to gain inspiration for the next crafting project.
